204835327_f07c04cf.text: Further morphological and electrophysiological analyses showed that four IN types could be identified among the EYFP-expressing cells: CCK/cannabinoid receptor type 1 (CB1R)-expressing basket cells, neurogliaform cells, PV+ basket cells, and PV+ axo-axonic cells.

204835327_df0cf3d4.text: The current findings add to a growing literature by describing a unique population of INs in the BA that, when activated, exert strong modulatory effects on extinction.
